patterns_identified.name: Docker-Compose Import Gap Persistence
patterns_identified.description: The docker-compose to cloud-native import gap appeared in both Nov 26 (idea:155) and Dec 10 (idea:167) data with high mention counts (29+ mentions on Dec 10), indicating persistent industry pain point that remains unresolved.
evidence: Same pain point identified in idea:155 (Nov 26)
patterns_identified.recommendation: Document current docker-compose → Terraform mapping. Automate when tooling matures (Q1 2026).
patterns_identified.validation: Consistent appearance across 2 weeks validates this is not a fleeting trend

patterns_identified.name: Container Observability Complexity Creep
patterns_identified.description: Self-hosted Grafana/Loki/Prometheus stacks for Docker can become complex and resource-intensive over time, with label explosion, maintenance overhead, and configuration complexity. Managed services provide simpler alternative.
evidence: HN article: 'I can't recommend Grafana anymore' (128 points)
Developer experience: simple docker-compose.yml → complex over time
patterns_identified.recommendation: Continue using Google Cloud managed services. Avoid self-hosted observability stack.
patterns_identified.validation: Chained's current architecture avoids this complexity by using Cloud Logging/Monitoring

patterns_identified.name: IDE-Terminal-Container Integration Trend
patterns_identified.description: Emerging IDEs (Cursor, Zed) and terminals (Warp) integrate code editing, AI assistance, terminal, and Docker management into single platforms, reducing context switching and improving developer experience.
evidence: Warp Terminal: 600k+ developers, AI Docker debugging
Cursor IDE: Full-stack development mention in TLDR
Trend: All-in-one developer platforms replacing fragmented tooling
patterns_identified.recommendation: Monitor Cursor/Warp maturity. Evaluate in Q2 2026 if productivity benefits proven (>15% improvement).
patterns_identified.validation: Current VS Code + GitHub Copilot sufficient for 1-2 developer team

patterns_identified.name: Technology Integration Over Fragmentation
patterns_identified.description: Industry trend toward integrating previously separate domains: hardware+software (Apple satellite), local+cloud (docker-compose import), specialized+general (full-stack), IDE+terminal+cloud. Reflects broader movement away from fragmented tooling.
evidence: TLDR title: 'Apple satellite 🛰️, inside Cursor 👨‍💻, becoming full stack 💼'
IDE + terminal + container + AI = single platform
patterns_identified.recommendation: No immediate action. Validates Chained's full-stack autonomous agent approach aligns with industry direction.
patterns_identified.validation: Chained's agents already embody 'full-stack' approach (learn → idea → code → PR)

decisions_validated.decision: Use Google Cloud Run for container deployment
decisions_validated.validation: Serverless containers avoid docker-compose local-to-cloud complexity, self-hosted observability setup overhead, and container orchestration management
supporting_evidence: docker-compose import gap still unresolved (29 mentions)
Cloud Run provides managed scaling and monitoring
decisions_validated.re_evaluate_when: Services >50, Team >10, Monthly cost >$1000, 24/7 high traffic

decisions_validated.decision: Use Google Cloud managed observability (Logging + Monitoring)
decisions_validated.validation_source: HN article: 'I can't recommend Grafana anymore' (128 points)
decisions_validated.validation: Self-hosted Grafana/Loki/Prometheus creates maintenance overhead, resource consumption, label explosion, and complexity creep. Managed services scale automatically and require zero configuration.
supporting_evidence: Developer report: Grafana simple → complex over time
decisions_validated.re_evaluate_when: Cloud Run monitoring insufficient, Monthly logs >100GB, Custom metrics requirements beyond defaults, Team >10 developers

decisions_validated.decision: Continue with VS Code + GitHub Copilot
decisions_validated.validation_source: Cursor IDE trend analysis (TLDR, Warp Terminal sponsor)
decisions_validated.validation: Current tools sufficient for 1-2 developer team. New IDEs (Cursor, Warp) emerging but not yet proven for productivity improvements. Unproven 10-20% productivity claims.
supporting_evidence: Cursor IDE mentioned in TLDR (growing awareness)
IDE integration trend is real but not urgent
decisions_validated.re_evaluate_when: Team >5 developers, Cursor >1M users, Proven productivity benefit >15%, VS Code development stagnates

decisions_validated.decision: Manual docker-compose → Terraform sync acceptable for now
decisions_validated.validation: Industry-wide pain point but tools not yet mature. Manual process acceptable at current scale (13 services, 1-2 developers). Automation when tooling available.
supporting_evidence: GitHub Copilot feature not yet released
29 mentions Dec 10 = high pain point signal
decisions_validated.re_evaluate_when: AWS/GitHub Copilot releases import feature, Configuration drift causes production issues, Services >25, Team >5

ecosystem_relevance_breakdown.justification: Medium-low relevance. Valuable awareness of Docker ecosystem evolution. Validates current Cloud Run architecture. No urgent changes needed. Documentation recommended for knowledge preservation.

IDE integration trend (Cursor, Warp) growing but not urgent - monitor for maturity
